text:
Maria (Partnerships): heads-up from Kronos SI — they want a hardened, offline "uploader appliance" option for Datadog telemetry from on-prem inference racks. Goal: no collector outbound, operator plugs thumbdrive into appliance, appliance bundles + signs telemetry, operator uploads to a secure Datadog intake. Can we sketch a non-invasive demo?

Jon (Product): idea: a tiny read-only appliance image (container or bootable) that mounts host cgroups, scrapes metrics via procfs and receives OTLP from local sidecars, then writes a signed ndjson tar. advantage: single binary we support. downside: operator UX.

Lina (Obs Eng): technically feasible. pattern: otelcol -> file exporter -> postprocessor (PII scrub + rate-limit) -> sign(gpg/ed25519) -> tar.gz. We'll include a manifest.json with schema version + span mapping. Demo will include a Datadog offline ingestion helper script on our side.

Hiro (HW Partnerships): hardware constraints: some customers run read-only rootfs and no writable /tmp. appliance needs to support external mount points and stream directly to mounted USB. Also check TPM use for signing keys on appliance vs. operator-managed keys.

Lina (Obs Eng): quick config snippet for demo (placeholders):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
  resource/enrich: {}
exporters:
  file:
    path: "/mnt/usb/telemetry-ndjson"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [resource/enrich, batch]
      exporters: [file]
```
Postprocess: gzip + sign with customer's public key or our demo key.

Maria (Partnerships): legal/infosec note: Kronos said their compliance team requires a signed audit manifest and a deletion confirmation step on the appliance after export. We should add that to the demo.

Jon (Product): UX: make a one-button flow on a small web UI served by the appliance: "Collect -> Scrub -> Bundle -> Sign -> Eject USB" and an operator acknowledgment checkbox. Keep it offline by design.

Datadog Bot: See offline trace ingestion notes: https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/traces/#offline-ingestion (shared).

Lina (Obs Eng): action items: 1) Lina: build minimal appliance prototype + scrubbing pipeline 2) Hiro: validate folder mount/usb constraints on Kronos hardware 3) Jon: wire a simple UI mock and the demo acceptance criteria 4) Maria: book a 60-min demo slot with Kronos. I'll add a small sample dashboard JSON that maps span attributes to our perf panels.

Maria (Partnerships): perfect. prefer short replies here; we'll open a dedicated runbook thread after the prototype. :rocket:
